name: Huttons Asia
summary: Large agency presence for rentals and purchases across Singapore districts.
body: Use agency scale for inventory breadth, then judge the agent on response time and contract hygiene. Never skip reading the tenancy agreement because someone is 'in a hurry.' On the buy side, treat ABSD and BSD timelines as critical path — foreigners often underestimate cash due within days of the OTP. Ask whether the agent has closed FTA-remission purchases before if you are US or EFTA-national; process mistakes are expensive at 60% ABSD.
